import java.util.*;

    public static void main(String[] args) {
        Scanner s = new Scanner(System.in);
        String[] firstLine = s.nextLine().split(" ");
        int n = Integer.parseInt(firstLine[0]);
        int bitCoins = Integer.parseInt(firstLine[1]);
        String[] values = s.nextLine().split(" ");
        
        int odd = 0;
        int even = 0;
        int count = 0;
        List<Integer> costs = new ArrayList<>();
        
        for (int i = 0; i < n - 1; i++) {
            int currentVal = Integer.parseInt(values[i]);
            if (currentVal % 2 == 0) {
                even++;
            } else {
                odd++;
            }
            
            if (odd == even) {
                int nextVal = Integer.parseInt(values[i + 1]);
                int diff = Math.abs(nextVal - currentVal);
                costs.add(diff);
            }
        }

        for (int cost : costs) {
            if (bitCoins >= cost) {
                bitCoins -= cost;
                count++;
            } else {
                break;
            }
        }
        
        System.out.println(count);
    }
}

import java.util.*;

public class Cutting {

    public static void main(String[] args) {
        Scanner s = new Scanner(System.in);
        String[] tokens = s.nextLine().split(" ");
        int n = Integer.parseInt(tokens[0]);
        int coins = Integer.parseInt(tokens[1]);
        String[] arr = s.nextLine().split(" ");
        
        int oddCount = 0, evenCount = 0, result = 0;
        PriorityQueue<Integer> minHeap = new PriorityQueue<>();
        
        for (int i = 0; i < n - 1; i++) {
            int num = Integer.parseInt(arr[i]);
            if (num % 2 == 0) evenCount++;
            else oddCount++;
            
            if (oddCount == evenCount) {
                int nextNum = Integer.parseInt(arr[i + 1]);
                int diff = Math.abs(nextNum - num);
                minHeap.offer(diff);
            }
        }
        
        while (!minHeap.isEmpty() && coins >= minHeap.peek()) {
            coins -= minHeap.poll();
            result++;
        }
        
        System.out.println(result);
    }
}

import java.util.*;

public class Cutting {

    public static void main(String[] args) {
        Scanner s = new Scanner(System.in);
        String[] line1 = s.nextLine().split(" ");
        int length = Integer.parseInt(line1[0]);
        int money = Integer.parseInt(line1[1]);
        String[] data = s.nextLine().split(" ");
        
        int odd = 0, even = 0, total = 0;
        int[] diffs = new int[length];
        int diffIndex = 0;
        
        for (int i = 0; i < length - 1; i++) {
            int current = Integer.parseInt(data[i]);
            if (current % 2 == 0) even++;
            else odd++;
            
            if (odd == even) {
                int next = Integer.parseInt(data[i + 1]);
                int diff = next - current;
                if (diff < 0) diff = -diff;
                diffs[diffIndex++] = diff;
            }
        }
        
        Arrays.sort(diffs, 0, diffIndex);
        for (int i = 0; i < diffIndex; i++) {
            if (money >= diffs[i]) {
                money -= diffs[i];
                total++;
            } else {
                break;
            }
        }
        
        System.out.println(total);
    }
}
